title: Israel says it killed a top Hamas commander in southern Gaza
summary: AP, Reuters and Al Jazeera report that an overnight strike in southern Gaza killed Samir Abu Younis, a Hamas Rafah brigade commander, and that Hamas confirmed his death. Reuters and Al Jazeera report that medics said others were wounded in the Mawasi area of Khan Younis. The reports describe the event as occurring on November 14; this is subsequent reporting, not a newly dated November 15 strike.
